BETA Close X Barratt Redrow plc has announced the purchase of 2,551,000 ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £386 million share repurchase program. These purchases occurred between September 7 and September 11, 2026, with prices ranging from 282.50 pence to 305.30 pence per share. Following these transactions, the company holds no shares in treasury, and its total issued ordinary shares stand at 1,390,366,419, with a corresponding total of voting rights. Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 14 September 2026 14 September 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transaction in Own Shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 7 September 2026 to 11 September 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from Barclays Bank plc ("Barclays") as part of its £386 million share repurchase programme announced on 15 July 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from Barclays as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE"). Date of Purchase within Disclosure Period Aggregate volume (shares) Highest price paid per share (pence) Lowest price paid per share (pence) Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence) Trading venue 07 Sep 2026 468,000 305.3000 301.3000 303.6731 LSE 08 Sep 2026 551,000 301.5000 295.7000 298.7506 LSE 09 Sep 2026 551,000 298.3000 291.0000 294.5199 LSE 10 Sep 2026 551,000 295.8000 288.4000 291.5013 LSE 11 Sep 2026 551,000 288.5000 282.5000 284.8186 LSE To date, Barratt Redrow has purchased 20,153,834 ordinary shares in aggregate for cancellation from Barclays in accordance with the Buyback Programme. Following the above purchases and cancellation of the ordinary shares, the Company holds no ordinary shares in treasury and has 1,390,366,419 ordinary shares in issue. The total number of voting rights in the Company is therefore 1,390,366,419.
